limits: This receipt is bounded to metadata. Unrelated inherited members, collections, enums, helpers and public APIs remain visible in the full API inventory; no whole-public-API conformance claim.

source_conversion_observation.source_parser_quirk: Pinned parser slices the first 19 characters and applies an offset only when the suffix length is six; other suffixes can be ignored. The target rejects malformed timezone syntax rather than importing this permissiveness.
source_conversion_observation.mapping: Supplemental original cases prove strict target syntax, invalid-date rejection and UTC values; source-specific parser mechanics are not a public format compatibility promise.

observations.behavior: Zero or more custData children precede optional tags child; preserve existing custom XML references.
custDataLst follows bg/spTree and precedes controls/extLst.
Required name and val are xsd:string; product preserves case and explicit empty values, while lookup names obey nonempty command contract.
Zero or more tag elements; duplicate-name ambiguity is explicit product validation, not inferred uniqueness in this schema.
